description: This PHP source file defines the 'AdminFootprintEditForm' class, which extends an abstract form processor and is used to create and handle a form for editing 'footprint' entities in an admin interface. The class includes methods to build the form with fields like name, title, description, icon, SDGs, categories, and social commitments, as well as to validate and save the form data.

classes.name: AdminFootprintEditForm
classes.description: Represents a form processor for editing footprint data in the admin interface, handling form creation, validation, and saving.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Constructs the form with fields for name, title, description, icon, SDGs, categories, and social commitments, configuring properties, choices, and labels.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the form data into the model, handling file uploads, relations, and error management.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Provides validation constraints for the form, ensuring the 'name' field is not blank.
